headline: Weathered Expanse Turns Colonial; Mooring County Seesaw Rolls On
war_summary: Since our last edition the balance in Weathered Expanse has turned: ground that stood under the Warden flag now reads four Colonial posts to two Warden, with three bases laid in ruin, and Crow's Nest remains that line's busiest post while the hourly toll climbs anew. Mooring County keeps its six-to-five Colonial margin, but the seesaw has not stopped—flags moved as this edition went to press, The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast the busiest grounds, and the day's casualty rolls now top 17,000 apiece. Callums Cape runs a close second; no flags have fallen there these two hours, yet the wounded come at roughly a thousand an hour on both sides. Linn Mercy, wholly Colonial since our last report, has been still since the small hours. Stlican Shelf, Stonecradle, Godcrofts and Nevish Line show no fresh flag movement, Callahans Passage shows rising casualty tallies without a flag stirring, and Marban Hollow stays split three apiece. Four of every five strategic posts across the map fly Colonial colours. It is the 805th day of the war; thirty-four victory towns must fall, and no victor is declared.
